basics.name: Alexander Prytula
basics.label: Backend / AI Engineer
basics.summary: Hands-on Backend and AI Engineer with over 8 years of experience designing, building, and scaling distributed microservices. Specialized in Node.js, Go, and Python, with practical experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) and vector databases. Strong background in system performance optimization, microservices testing, observability, and building robust CI/CD pipelines.
